title: No need to wait for green in IndexDiskUsageAnalyzerIT

timeline.message: No need to wait for green in IndexDiskUsageAnalyzerIT
timeline.author: Nhat Nguyen

timeline.body:
The test `testFailOnFlush` fails if the number of replicas is one and the cluster has a single data node. We don't need to wait for indices to be green in these tests.

Closes #84789
Should we wait for yellow before indexing below?

reply.body: By default we [wait](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/12ad399c488f0cc60e19b5e1b29c6d569cb4351a/client/rest-high-level/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/client/indices/CreateIndexRequest.java#L309-L322) for all primary copies active when creating an index.
